title: Check If String Is Transformable With Substring Sort Operations
description: Determine if string s can become string t by sorting substrings. This is possible if for every digit 0-9, the occurrences appear in the same relative order in both strings.
pseudocode:
1. Store indices of each digit 0-9 in lists
2. For each digit d in t:
3. If no occurrences of d left, return false
4. Check if any smaller digit appears before the next occurrence of d in s
5. If yes, return false; else, pop index and continue

steps.note: Check if any 0 exists before the first 1. No, index 0 is valid.
Check if any digit < 0 exists before index 2. None exist.
Check if any 0 exists before index 1. No 0s remain.
